name: bloomlaunch-contracts
description: BloomLaunch smart contracts: token launchpad on Elysium (bonding curves that present as Uniswap V3 pools, Uniswap V4 graduation with locked liquidity, holder rewards, buybacks, BLOOM burn, HyperEVM-Elysium fee bridge).

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/contracts.test.mjs test/v4.test.mjs test/deploy.test.mjs test/migration.test.mjs test/bloom.test.mjs test/invariants.test.mjs test/v2.test.mjs test/bridge.test.mjs
scripts.deploy:elysium: npm run build:production && DEPLOY_CONFIG=config/deploy.elysium-mainnet.json RPC_URL=https://rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz node scripts/deploy.mjs --execute --confirm-mainnet
